info.title: Distribution-transformer digital twin API
info.description: Wraps dt/api.py. Timestamps ISO 8601 with offset; NaN -> null. Everything generated is SIMULATED (see `simulated` fields).

get.description: api.list_datasets() — cached scenarios, Kaggle and uploads.

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api Datasets Get

post.description: api.load_file() — upload, map, run the twin and analytics, cache the run, register the dataset.
api.inspect_file() — auto-mapping proposal for the Import page. Nothing is stored.

get.description: api.get_run() — summary, analysis, and every numeric trend/twin/health column as a series.
api.state_at() — twin, Health Index and the last 24 h of alerts at time t.
api.replay() — NDJSON stream of StateAt objects.

parameters.name: speed

schema.description: data-seconds per wall-second; omit = no waiting
schema.title: Speed

parameters.description: data-seconds per wall-second; omit = no waiting

200.description: one StateAt JSON object per line

get.description: api.frames() — every sample, aligned on one time axis, for replay and full-resolution charts.
api.thermal_profile() — bottom/top oil, winding, hot-spot, losses, heat flow, oil flow, radiator effectiveness.
api.components() — per-part quantities, governing equations with live values, findings and tests.
api.whatif() — steady state, ageing, time to steady state and the approach curve.

parameters.name: t

schema.description: start the approach from the twin state at t
schema.title: T

parameters.description: start the approach from the twin state at t

get.description: api.findings() — findings on parts grouped by CPRI cause, recommendations, through-fault stress.

parameters.name: t

schema.description: findings up to t; omit = whole run
schema.title: T

parameters.description: findings up to t; omit = whole run

get.description: api.self_test() — CPRI Excel format: reference vs software, diff, % diff, pass (<= 1 %), trip checks.
api.snapshot_table() — records (or daily peak operating points) ranked worst Health Index first.
api.report() — self-contained print-ready HTML (inline SVG charts), the full CSV, or JSON.
api.report_pdf() — not built yet: 501 with the reason.
api.presets() — example profiles (Transformer-1, a nameplate-derived 1250 kVA, generic ratings) with value tags.

schema.title: Response Get Presets Api Presets Get

post.description: api.resolve_profile() — complete a typed profile: rated current, loss split, IEC defaults, every value tagged.
api.simulate() — generate a SIMULATED scenario for any transformer profile and run the full pipeline.
api.ingest() — append readings from a device to a live session; it appears as the dataset u-live-<session>.

delete.description: api.end_live() — forget a live session and its cached run.

post.description: api.physics_chain() — load -> top-oil -> hot-spot -> ageing with the IEC 60076-7 equations and this asset's numbers.
api.physics_step() — oil and winding hot-spot after a load step (thermal time constants made visible).
api.physics_detailed() — the IEC model and the detailed heat-balance model on one load step, with loss breakdown.

get.description: api.physics_ageing_models() — the 6 K rule and Arrhenius ageing curves side by side.

post.description: api.physics_whatif() — the dataset's own load and weather replayed under changed load, ambient and cooling.

get.description: api.brief() — status sentence, ranked diagnosis, maintenance work order, headroom and time-to-limit at time t.
api.outlook() — Monte Carlo remaining insulation life (P10/P50/P90 and fan), 30-day risk and a 24 h forecast from t.

post.description: Queue a TEST alert. Companion apps that are listening (they poll GET /api/companion/test-alerts) show it as a notification.

get.description: Test alerts queued from the dashboard. A client calls once without `since` to learn `latest`, then polls with since=latest.

parameters.name: since

schema.description: return alerts with seq > since; omit to learn the latest seq
schema.title: Since

get.description: The pre-written response for every alert type (companion/content/responses.json), for the dashboard's anomaly tests.
